articles.description: Inama n'ubuyobozi ku bijanye n'imbuga, ugukoresha ibintu mu buryo bwa wenyine (automatisation) no gukuza ubucuruzi bwawe kuri interineti.
articles.empty: Nta nyandiko ziraboneka. Subira kuza vuba.

hero.board.title: Urubaho rwo gutangura
services.description: Duhuza ingene inyandiko zitegurwa, igishushanyo c'urubuga hamwe n'ubuhinga, kugira ngo urubuga rwawe rutaba ruri kuri interineti gusa, ahubwo rukore neza koko.
services.0.title: Portfolio / CV bwite
services.0.description: Urubuga rwa portfolio canke CV bwite rwo kwerekana ibigukwerekeye, ubunararibonye n'ibikorwa vyawe mu buryo bw'umwuga.
services.1.title: Landing page canke urubuga rw'ikigo
services.1.description: Landing page canke urubuga rw'ikigo ruhita rusohoka vyihuse, rushikana kandi rwiteguye gukurura abakiriya.
services.2.title: Sisitemu y'amakuru n'iy'imikorere
services.2.description: Utubaho tw'amakuru, imiryango n'amasisitemu y'imbere yo gucunga amakuru yawe n'imikorere ya buri musi y'ubucuruzi bwawe.
services.3.title: Automatisation
services.3.description: Korosha imirimo isubirwamwo kenshi nko kumenyesha, guhuza ibikoresho n'uburyo bw'akazi, kugira ngo abakozi bawe barokore igihe.
process.description: Icatuwe cose gifise ivyo ushobora kubona, kugerageza no kwemeza. Uramenya neza aho akazi kageze.
process.0.title: Gusuzuma ivyo ukeneye
process.0.description: Dushira ahabona intumbero z'ubucuruzi, ivyerekanwa ukunda, ibikorwa nyamukuru n'ivyo gushira imbere.
process.1.title: Gusubiramwo igishushanyo
process.1.description: Imiterere, igishushanyo n'inzira vyisubirwamwo kandi bikemezwa hamwe imbere yo gutangura gukora.
process.2.title: Gukora
process.2.description: Urubuga, porogaramu canke automatisation bikorwa bihuza n'ecran zose hisunzwe igishushanyo cemejwe.
process.3.title: Gusuzuma ivyavuyemwo
process.3.description: Ivyavuyemwo turasubiramwo hamwe, tukabikosora nimba bikenewe, tukabigerageza gushika vyiteguye gushirwa ahabona.
process.4.title: Gushira ahabona no gutanga
process.4.description: Igikorwa kirashirwa ahabona, metadata na SEO bigatunganywa, hanyuma tukaguha uburyo bwo kwinjira n'ubuyobozi.
services.0.long: Urubuga rwa portfolio canke CV bwite ni urugo rwawe rwemewe kuri interineti. Ibigukwerekeye, ubunararibonye n'ibikorwa vyawe bikusanyirizwa ku rupapuro rumwe boroshe gusangiza abakoresha, abakiriya canke za kaminuza.
services.0.detail.0: Incamake y'ibigukwerekeye n'ingene akazi kagiye gakurikirana
services.0.detail.2: CV yo gukurura mu buryo bwa PDF
services.0.detail.3: Buto yo kukwandikira n'amahuriro y'imbuga nkoranyambaga
services.0.detail.4: Isa neza kuri telefone no kuri ordinateri
services.0.for: Abarangije vuba amashure, abakora bigenga, abakora ibihangano n'abakozi bashaka kwerekana ko bashobora.
services.1.long: Landing page canke urubuga rw'ikigo rufasha ubucuruzi gusiga ishusho nziza ku ncuro ya mbere. Dutegura inzira y'urupapuro, inyandiko n'isura kugira ngo abarusuye bahite bumva ivyo utanga kandi bumve bashaka kukwandikira.
services.1.detail.2: Ifishi yo kukwandikira na buto ya WhatsApp
services.1.detail.3: SEO kugira ngo bakubone vyoroshe kuri Google
services.1.for: Ubucuruzi, amashure, amakawa, amakoraniro n'ibigo bishaka gusa neza nk'abanyamwuga.
services.2.long: Sisitemu y'amakuru itunganya akazi kari mu mpapuro za kabaruramari, mu nyandiko no mu butumwa. Amakuru aba ahantu hamwe, akaboneka hisunzwe inshingano z'umuntu, kandi raporo ushobora kuzibona igihe cose.
services.2.detail.0: Uburyo bw'akazi buhinnye bukurikira ingene ukora
services.2.detail.4: Ikibanza c'umuyobozi co gucunga ivyo urubuga rwerekana wewe ubwawe
services.2.for: Amashure, ibigo, amaduka, ibibanza vy'ubworozi n'ibigo bishaka gucunga amakuru yavyo neza kurusha.
services.3.long: Imirimo isubirwamwo kenshi nko kurungika ubutumwa, kuvana amakuru kuri porogaramu imwe ukayajana ku yindi canke gukora raporo z'imisi yose irashobora kwikora. Abakozi bawe barokora igihe kandi bakirinda amakosa yo kwandika.
services.3.detail.1: Ubutumwa bwikora kuri WhatsApp canke kuri imeri
services.3.detail.2: Inzira zikora zo kwemeza no gukora raporo
services.3.for: Ubucuruzi n'amatsinda bifise akazi kenshi gasubirwamwo n'ukuboko.
process.0.long: Imbere yo kubaka ikintu, dushaka gusobanukirwa ubucuruzi bwawe: intumbero ni iyihe, abarusura ni bande, n'ibikorwa ibihe bifise agaciro kanini. Duhava dushira ivyo gushira imbere kugira ngo akazi kaguma gafise intumbero kandi ntihatakare amahera.
process.0.do.0: Kumviriza intumbero n'ivyo ubucuruzi bwawe bugamije
process.0.do.2: Guhitamwo ibikorwa nyamukuru n'ingene akazi gakurikirana
process.0.you: Tubwire ivyo ukeneye kandi usangize ingero z'imbuga ukunda.
process.0.result: Urutonde rw'ivyo ukeneye n'ivyo gushira imbere vyemeranijweho hamwe.
process.1.long: Duheza gutegura imiterere y'impapuro n'ishusho y'isura. Urashobora kuyisubiramwo no gutanga ingingo zawe imbere yo gutangura kubaka, kugira ngo ivyavuyemwo bisigare hafi y'ivyo wiyumvira.
process.1.do.1: Gushushanya isura: amabara, imiterere n'imvugo y'isura
process.1.you: Subiramwo igishushanyo, hanyuma utange ingingo zawe canke ukiyemeze.
process.1.result: Igishushanyo cemeranijweho hamwe imbere yo gutangura gukora.
process.2.long: Igishushanyo kimaze kwemezwa, urubuga, porogaramu canke automatisation birubakwa. Bihuza na telefone na ordinateri, kandi urashobora gutanga ingingo zawe akazi kakiri gukorwa.
process.2.do.1: Kurabira ko bisa neza kuri telefone, tablette na ordinateri
process.2.do.2: Gutegura ivy'ibanze kugira ngo bikubonwe vyoroshe kuri Google
process.2.do.3: Gusangiza aho akazi kageze buri gihe
process.2.you: Tegura inyandiko, amafoto na logo, hanyuma usangize ingingo zawe igihe uzifise.
process.2.result: Verisiyo ya mbere ushobora kugerageza. Urubuga rworoshe ruba rwarangiye mu misi 1–3 y'akazi iyo ibikoresho vyiteguye.
process.3.long: Turagerageza ivyavuyemwo hamwe. Ivyo bitari bigeze neza birakosorwa, hanyuma vyose bigaterageza kandi gushika bikora neza ku bikoresho bitandukanye kandi vyiteguye gushirwa ahabona.
process.3.do.0: Kurabira isura ku ngero zitandukanye z'ecran
process.3.you: Gerageza ivyavuyemwo hanyuma utubwire ivyo wipfuza ko bihinduka.
process.4.long: Igikorwa kirashirwa ahabona kigafungurirwa bose. Tugitegura kugira ngo kiboneke vyoroshe kuri Google, hanyuma tukaguha uburyo bwo kwinjira hamwe n'igitabu c'ukuntu bikoreshwa kugira ngo ubicunge neza.
process.4.do.2: Gutanga uburyo bwo kwinjira n'igitabu c'ukuntu bikoreshwa
process.4.do.3: Kugushigikira mu mwaka 1 w'ubuntu wo kubungabunga, hiyongereyeko domaine (Ipaki Nto) canke hosting (Ipaki Nini)
process.4.you: Rinda uburyo bwawe bwo kwinjira kandi utangure kubusangiza abakiriya bawe.
process.4.result: Urubuga canke porogaramu biri kuri interineti kandi vyiteguye gukoreshwa.
projects.description: Umushinga wose watunganijwe kugira ngo uvuge neza ubutumwa bw'ubucuruzi, uhuze n'igikoresho cose, kandi woroshe abakoresha gukora igikorwa.
packages.description: Igiciro gishobora guhindurwa nyuma y'inama kugira ngo ingengo y'imari, igihe n'ivyavuyemwo bigume vyoroshe.
packages.0.name: Nto
packages.1.name: Nini
packages.0.description: Urubuga rwa portfolio, CV bwite canke landing page yoroshe isohoka vyihuse.
packages.1.description: Urubuga rw'ikigo, sisitemu y'amakuru n'iy'imikorere, canke automatisation yateguwe hisunzwe ivyo ukeneye.
faq.title: Ibibazo bibazwa kenshi imbere yo gutangura.
faq.description: Nimba ikibazo cawe kitasubirijwe hano, inama zishobora gufasha kumenya ivyo ukeneye.
faq.0.question: Nocoding ishobora gukora serivisi izihe?
faq.0.answer: Dukora imbuga za portfolio canke CV bwite, landing page canke imbuga z'ibigo, amasisitemu y'amakuru n'ay'imikorere, hamwe na automatisation y'imikorere y'ubucuruzi.
faq.1.question: Gukora bifata igihe kingana iki?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV canke landing page yoroshe isanzwe ifata iminsi 1-3 y'akazi ibikoresho bimaze kwitegura. Imishinga minini iterwa n'ibikorwa bikenewe, ingene bihuzwa, n'ingene ingingo zitangwa vyihuse.
faq.2.question: Igishushanyo n'ibikorwa vyohindurwa?
faq.2.answer: Ego. Igishushanyo, imiterere y'impapuro, ibikorwa n'uburyo bw'akazi bishobora gutegurwa hisunzwe ivyo ukeneye. Igishushanyo kirasubirwamwo hamwe imbere yo gutangura gukora.
faq.3.question: Igiciro gikubiyemwo iki?
faq.3.answer: Igiciro gikubiyemwo gukora hisunzwe ipaki n'ingano vyemeranijweho. Ipaki Nto irimwo kubungabunga na domaine vy'ubuntu mu mwaka 1, naho Ipaki Nini irimwo kubungabunga na hosting vy'ubuntu mu mwaka 1.
contact.title: Tubwire ivyo urubuga rwawe rukeneye. Tuzogufasha gutunganya inzira.
contact.description: Rungika incamake y'ubucuruzi bwawe, impapuro ushaka n'igihe wipfuza. Igisubizo ca mbere kizokubamwo inama ku ngano y'akazi n'intambwe zikurikira. Inama ni iz'ubuntu buri gihe, igihe cose uzikeneye.
footer.tagline: Imbuga z'ubucuruzi ziteguye gusohoka, zisa nk'izikomeye kandi zoroshe gukura.
project.description.ecoswap: Isoko rya interineti ryo kugura no kugurisha ibintu vyakoreshejwe. Abantu barashobora gushiraho, gushakisha no kugura vyoroshe kuri telefone canke ordinateri.
project.description.wiboost: Iduka rya interineti rya serivisi za digitale nko kuzuza ama-jeux, ama-paki ya data na porogaramu za premium, hamwe n'amafaranga y'abakiriya na gahunda y'abagurisha bundi bushasha.
project.description.ahawi: Urubuga rwa portfolio bwite rufise isura y'ishusho ry'amazi y'amabara n'indimi zibiri, rwo kwerekana ibimukwerekeye, ubunararibonye n'uburyo bwo kumutunga.
project.description.abdi: Sisitemu y'amakuru y'abakozi b'ingoro (abdi dalem) ya Keraton ya Surakarta: kwiyandikisha, amakuru bwite, gahunda y'ibikorwa, kuboneka n'icapwa ry'amakarita y'indangamuntu.
project.description.sfarm: Porogaramu yo gucunga ubworozi bw'inkoko zitera amagi n'ihene bw'umudugudu: inyandiko za buri musi, kugurisha, amafaranga atanzwe na raporo z'imari.
project.description.payu: Urubuga ruhuza abatanga imirimo n'abakora bigenga. Utanga umurimo atanga ingabire, uwukora akarangiza akazi, maze kwishura bigakorwa na QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Urutonde rwa interineti rufise ibicuruzwa birenga igihumbi. Abaguzi barashobora gushakisha, guhitamwo no gutumiza mu buryo butaziguye kuri WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Iduka rya interineti rya porogaramu za premium
project.description.ianprem: Iduka rya interineti rya konti za porogaramu za premium nka Netflix na Spotify. Abaguzi barahitamwo bakishura bonyene, naho abayobozi bagacunga ububiko n'ibigurishwa.
project.category.alengka: Urubuga rw'urutonde rw'ibikoresho vyo mu nzu
project.description.alengka: Urutonde rwa interineti rw'ibikoresho vyo mu nzu no hanze vy'amakawa, amaresitora n'ingo. Abasuye barashobora kubona ibihari no kubaza kuri WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Urubuga rwemewe rw'ishure ry'incuke rufise amakuru y'ishure, amakuru yo kwakira abanyeshure bashasha, urutonde rw'abarimu, ibikorwa vyo hanze y'ishure n'ivyo abanyeshure bagezeho.
project.category.furnix: Urubuga rw'urutonde rw'ibikoresho vyo mu nzu
project.description.furnix: Urutonde rwa interineti rw'ibikoresho vy'icuma biva i Jepara vy'amakawa, amaresitora n'ingo. Abasuye barashobora guhitamwo ibicuruzwa bagatumiza uko bishakiye.
project.description.clothique: Iduka rya interineti ry'imyambaro ryuzuye: urutonde, agaseke ko guhahiramwo, kwishura kuri interineti, blog n'ikibanza c'umuyobozi co gucunga ibitumizwa na raporo.
project.category.agli: Porogaramu ifasha gukora ibikubiye mu butumwa
project.description.agli: Igikoresho c'amatsinda akora ibikubiye mu butumwa gikusanya ingero z'ibitazwi cane, kigatahura imiterere yavyo, kikandika ibigeragezo vy'inyandiko nshasha.
project.description.nebulist: Umufasha wo kugurisha akoresha AI ategura umugambi, inyandiko z'abakiriya bashobora kuboneka n'ibigeragezo vy'ubutumwa bishingiye ku makuru y'igicuruzwa.
project.description.carbonfi: Porogaramu y'imari ya digitale yo gucuruza ama-carbon credits (ingabire zo kugabanya imyuka mibi) na gahunda z'ingabire zirengera ibidukikije.
project.description.protectedpay: Porogaramu yizewe yo kurungika amafaranga ya digitale: amafaranga arekurwa gusa iyo yakiriwe, hamwe no kwishura mu matsinda no kuzigama.
project.category.pedulichain: Porogaramu yo gutanga ingabire kuri interineti
project.description.pedulichain: Urubuga rwo gutanga rufise ubuvyeyi: buri gitangwa n'ingene amafaranga akoreshwa vyandikwa burundu kandi bikaboneka na bose.
project.description.astra: Umufasha wa AI ushobora kuvugana na we gusa kugira ngo ucunge ibintu vya digitale, nko kurungika ama-token canke gukora ibintu vya digitale vyo gukusanya, ata bumenyi bwo kwandika porogaramu.
project.description.auditfi: Igikoresho gishingiye kuri AI co kugenzura umutekano wa porogaramu z'imari ya digitale gitahura ahantu hadakomeye hanyuma kikandika raporo mu masegonda.
project.category.p2p: Porogaramu yo guhanahana ibintu vya digitale
project.description.p2p: Urubuga rwo guhanahana ibintu vya digitale mu buryo butaziguye hagati y'abakoresha, hamwe no kurinda ibikorwa n'ikibanza c'umuyobozi co gucunga urubuga.
project.description.payguppy: Porogaramu ifasha amaduka asanzwe kwakira amafaranga ya digitale akoresheje amakode ya QR asanzwe afise.
project.description.tiptap: Urubuga rwo gufasha abakora ibikubiye mu butumwa kwakira ingabire ziva ku bayireba mu mafaranga ya digitale canke mu bintu vya digitale vyo gukusanya, hamwe n'amenyesha mu gihe c'ikiganiro kiri kuba.
project.description.senkus: Umukino wa interineti ushingiye ku bumenyi n'ubuhinga bwa alchimie: abakinnyi bavanga imiti, bakusanya ibintu vya digitale kandi bagahanganira mu rubuga.
project.description.quickstock: Porogaramu yo kuri ordinateri yo gucunga ububiko bw'iduka ry'imyambaro: kwandika ivyagurishijwe, ivyaje biva ku batanga ibintu na raporo z'ububiko, bifise uburenganzira bushingiye ku nshingano ya buri mukozi.
project.description.caer: Urubuga rwo kuguriza no kugurizwa ibintu vya digitale hagati y'imiyoboro hamwe n'inkunga y'irupiya ya digitale IDRX, byoroshe kuzigama no kuguzwa.

project.description.ineedsave: Urubuga rutishurwa rwo gukurura amashusho, amafoto n'amajwi biva kuri TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X n'izindi mbuga. Shiramwo ihuriro, hitamwo ubuziranenge, hanyuma ubibike.

project.description.ineedbarcode: Igikoresho gitishurwa co gukora barcode na QR code gifise ubwoko bwa barcode 100+. Abakoresha bashiramwo amakuru, bagahindura imiterere, bagakurura PNG yiteguye gucapwa.
